`TectonicEngine(RenderEngine)`:
- Imports `shutil` and `subprocess` at **module scope** so they can be patched independently.
- `__init__(timeout=60.0, allow_shell_escape=True)` — locates the binary with `shutil.which("tectonic")`; on success sets `_is_available=True` and `binary_path=Path(...)`, otherwise sets `_is_available=False` and logs a WARNING advising to install Tectonic on PATH.
- `is_available()` returns `self._is_available`.
- `render(tikz_code, preamble="", source_root=None)`:
  - Returns `None` immediately if unavailable.
  - Sanitizes the preamble, stages local dependencies (when `source_root` given), writes the `.tex`, and runs `subprocess.run(..., timeout=self.timeout, check=True)`.
  - The command includes `-Z shell-escape` only when `allow_shell_escape=True`; any arg starting with `search-path=` is filtered out.
  - Returns `None` on `subprocess.TimeoutExpired` and `subprocess.CalledProcessError`; otherwise rasterizes the first PDF page (via `pypdfium2`) into a PIL image.
- `_sanitize_preamble_for_tectonic(preamble)` (static) — replaces pdftex primitive **assignment** lines with `% docling: removed for Tectonic compatibility: <original_line>`, while leaving lines that merely reference/test a primitive (e.g. `\ifdefined\pdfoutput`, `\the\pdfpagewidth`) unchanged.
- `_stage_dependencies` copies referenced local files into the working dir preserving relative paths and **skips any file resolving outside `source_root`** (path-traversal control).

### `docling/datamodel/backend_options.py`
Added `tikz_engine: Optional[Literal["tectonic"]] = None` to `LatexBackendOptions`.

### `docling/backend/latex/backend.py`
`LatexDocumentBackend.__init__` instantiates a `TectonicEngine` into `self._tikz_engine` when `options.tikz_engine == "tectonic"` (lazy import).

### `docling/backend/latex/handlers/environments.py`
`_process_tikzpicture` now calls `_render_tikz`: if an available engine returns an image, it sets `picture.image`; if `render()` returns `None` or raises, it falls back to `picture.image=None` plus `picture.meta.code.text` (the `\begin{tikzpicture}...` markup) with `language=CodeLanguageLabel.TIKZ`. The preamble (text before `\begin{document}`) is passed along, and `source_root` is set to the file's parent when backed by a `Path`.

### Verification
- Manually exercised all paths: engine unavailable → code fallback; render → PIL image → `picture.image` set; render → `None`/exception → code fallback; `TimeoutExpired`/`CalledProcessError` → `None`; dependency staging preserves relative paths and blocks traversal; command flags correct for shell-escape on/off with no `search-path=`.
- Existing LaTeX suite: 74 pass. The one failing test (`test_e2e_latex_conversions`) fails identically on the base commit — pre-existing and unrelated. I did not touch any files under `tests/`.

Note: `ruff`/`mypy`/`uv` aren't installed in this environment so `make check`/`make validate` couldn't run, but I verified line-length (≤88) and `py_compile` on all changed files.
